rows.author: I114;
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT 8353, ALSO KNOWN AS THE ANTI-RAPE LAW OF 1997
rows.abstract:
Seeks to bring the prosecution and definition of rape up to modern standards, no longer placing the onus on the victim's refusal or resistance, or the specifics of the sexual act performed or attempted, but instead placing focus on consent of all parties.

Proposes to acknowledge and elaborate upon the circumstance which are to be considered as inherently coercive; increases the age of statutory rape to sixteen; and removes the qualifier, which requires that a person in authority must have taken advantage of their position.

Provides for increased compensation for victims under certain circumstances.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2019-02-04

rows.author: I114;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EMPLOYMENT OF NURSES, ASSIGNING ONE REGISTERED NURSE FOR EVERY BARANGAY IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Intends to tap our pool of qualified yet underemployed or unemployed nurses in the country for the purpose of improving the delivery of public health care services to the poorest communities in rural areas as well as underprivileged communities in the urban areas.

Proposes to enact a program whereby the government mobilizes these population of nurses in order to dispatch at least one registered nurse to every barangay whose duties include education with regards to the importance of health, hygiene, sanitation, and wellness.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2019-02-04

relevant research, scientific studies and market strategies, extending technologies and creating
international linkages for development and promotion of the industry and its products.

Provides for the composition of the National Cacao Development Council; the development of programs related to its objectives; and specifies its powers and functions.

Intends to provide greater support to the seed research and production that can create better
products such as hybrid seeds and to promote comprehensive quality seed production to farmers and farmer organizations by developing and propagating quality seeds for them.

Proposes to undertake a comprehensive program on the production of hybrid and other quality seeds at a subsidized cost, as well as encouraging farmers to intensify their efforts in increasing farm productivity.

rows.author: I114;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A MAGNA CARTA OF STUDENTS
rows.abstract:
Aims to elevate and clarify the rights of students as against authorities, as well as facilitate
the learning and dissemination of these rights by collating them in a single statute.

Proposes several provisions on freedom of access to education; right to organize and freedom of association; freedom of expression; academic rights; the right to adequate academic facilities; right to student employment; right to consultation, information and participation in policy making; creation of Student Ethics Committee; due process in disciplinary proceedings; and right to protection and privacy of official educational records.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE PRESERVATION, REFORESTATION, AFFORESTATION AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT OF MANGROVE FORESTS IN THE PHILIPPINES, PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to set aside portions of land solely for the development and sustainable management of mangrove forests, in all coastal areas in each municipality of the country; establishing the National Council for the Preservation of Mangrove Forests (NCPMF) and the Local Council for the Preservation of Mangrove Forests (LCPMF).

Seeks to employ the services of forest guards who shall be tasked to police the areas and shall have the authority to arrest those caught violating the provisions of this Act.

Enumerates prohibited acts within the mangrove reservation areas and provides for penalties for any person, natural or juridical, found guilty of violating any provisions of this Act.
rows.alias_name: "National Mangrove Forest Protection and Preservation Act"
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2019-02-04

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE SMALL AND MEDIUM  ENTERPRISES STOCK EXCHANGE
rows.abstract:
Proposes the creation of an efficient and effective SMEX  which will serve as the equities market of SMEs in order to broaden and deepen its capital markets through increased access to financing and therefore provides both foreign and local investors another opportunity for investment.

Provides that operation and activites of the SMEX shall be managed and controlled by the Board of Governors composed of the Governor of the BSP, SEC/PSE representative, and five members from the SMEX.
